ideas.name: Delisting announcement short grid
ideas.claim: Short a Binance USDT perpetual when its delisting is detected, and run a short grid until closing before delisting.
ideas.quote: The moment the announcement is detected and initialization runs, open a short at market — don’t wait for the grid:
ideas.mechanism: Delisting announcements trigger position closures and selling pressure.

rules.market: Binance USDT perpetual futures announced for delisting
rules.timeframe: Event-driven; the article describes delisting cycles lasting several days.
rules.entry: Poll exchangeInfo every 15 seconds for a changed deliveryDate; open a base market short and establish a 10-cell short grid spanning 10% below the initial price.
rules.exit: Cover grid shorts at their next lower grid level; force-close remaining positions 60 minutes before delisting. The article also describes optional earlier profit-protection exits.
rules.filters: USDT perpetual contracts with a deliveryDate changed to a future delisting timestamp.

ideas.claimed_result: The article states that MLNUSDT lost nearly one-third of its value within half an hour; it does not state an aggregate strategy result.
required_data: Historical Binance perpetual delisting detection timestamps
